en.title: The Bookstore of Leaves and the Twin Tsukuyomi
en.premise: In a secondhand bookstore that houses the 'Book of Kotodama'—a record of memories from the Age of the Gods—forgotten divine messengers occasionally pay a visit. The twin siblings who run the shop possess the power to manipulate the essence of human speech, tasked with weaving back memories long since lost. But when a mysterious traveler brings in an ancient tome, they discover forbidden words capable of overturning the very laws of existence. As the seasons shift, the twins begin a journey to uncover the truth behind an ancient promise made between gods and men.

zh.title: 言之叶古书店与双子月读
zh.premise: 在一家经营记录着神代记忆的《言灵之书》的古书店里，偶尔会有被世人遗忘的神使到访。身为店主的双胞胎兄妹操纵着寄宿在人类语言中的力量，承担着重写失落记忆的使命。然而某日，一名旅人带来的一本古书，其中记载着足以颠覆世间法则的禁忌言灵。在四季的流转之中，双胞胎逐渐揭开神与人之间那段古老约定的真相。
